description: This file provides a notes service with functions to fetch, add, and delete notes, supporting both localStorage and Supabase backend, with feature flag parsing and utility functions.

methods.name: parseFeatureFlags
methods.description: Parses feature flags from environment variables, with error handling.

methods.name: sanitizeContent
methods.description: Sanitizes and constrains note content to prevent HTML injection and limit length.

methods.name: toNote
methods.description: Converts raw database or local storage item to note object with id, content, and created_at.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from Supabase or localStorage, sorted by newest first.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a new note, using Supabase or localStorage fallback.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by id, using Supabase or localStorage fallback.

methods.name: cryptoRandomId
methods.description: Generates a reasonably unique id without external dependencies.

methods.name: isSupabaseEnabled
methods.description: Checks if Supabase client is available/enabled.
